$comment: Third-party semanticIds this crate is permitted to emit.
An entry here asserts, to a machine, that one of our fields means what a
standards body says its identifier means. That is a claim about someone
else's vocabulary, so it is only allowlisted once a human has read the
authority's own published source and recorded what they read.
Identifiers in the urn:odal-node: namespace need no entry — they are our
own concepts, honestly named, and the gate accepts them by prefix.
An entry missing verifiedOn or verifiedBy is refused by the gate. That is
deliberate: an unverified allowlist entry is worse than no allowlist,
because it converts a visible open question into an invisible blessing.
Five identifiers claiming IDTA and ECLASS authority were removed on
2026-07-29 rather than allowlisted — they were malformed, not merely

urn:samm:io.catenax.battery.battery_pass.verifiedBy: assisted web verification, pending founder sign-off
urn:samm:io.catenax.battery.battery_pass.meaning: Battery Pass aspect model, referenced by identifier only
urn:samm:io.catenax.battery.battery_pass.licence: not reproduced — identifier and citation only, see note
note: Confirmed present as a released aspect model at the source above, in
correct SAMM URN form, with 6.0.0 current (3.0.0 and 3.0.1 also exist).
verifiedBy is PROVISIONAL. Replace it with a name once a trusted
principal has read the source directly. The gate cannot tell the
difference — that is what this note is for.
The authority's own wording for the concept is deliberately NOT copied
here pending a licence check on redistribution, per the plan's licence
care step. Identifier plus citation only.
